cc:Work.dc:description: Role-wise empirical cumulative distributions use every actual request, without smoothing, binning or resampling. Panel a uses a common 0–65 second axis; panels b and c explicitly zoom each role using different x-axis ranges. Dashed vertical lines mark medians computed with the historical linear-quantile convention. The curves are descriptive distributions, not confidence intervals. Historical October 30, 2026 cohort: one NVIDIA H100 80 GB GPU and one fixed runtime. Each role has 200 measured requests from the same 50 scene groups, repeated four times; the 400 requests are not 400 independent scenes. Each request generates 24 future frames at 576 × 1024 with pretrained Vista and 50 denoising steps. Request latency includes input loading/preprocessing through host-ready frames and excludes initialization, compilation, warmups and output export. These figures describe performance and allocator memory only: held-out output-quality validation was not completed, and quality preservation is not established. No hardware cohorts are pooled.
